scope: Bounded acquisition of the two user-authorised official Spark-X2.6-4B snapshots into ignored local checkpoint directories. Every revision, file name, byte count and SHA256 is derived from configs/spark_source_preparation_v2.json and cross-checked against the retained preparation manifest. No model execution, no remote Python execution, no training-data access.

pins.policy: No revision, size or per-file SHA256 is authored here. The loader derives every pin from the pinned source-preparation plan and refuses to run if that plan's bytes, the preparation manifest's bytes, a repository revision or any file pin disagrees.

protocol.atomic_staging: Each snapshot is written into a same-filesystem <output>.staging-<revision> directory and renamed to the final path only after every file has the exact pinned size and SHA256.
protocol.resume_policy: Resume only from a verified partial prefix: the recorded byte offset and prefix SHA256 must match the bytes on disk; partials without state, short partials and hash-mismatched prefixes are refused, never appended to.
protocol.duplicate_payload_policy: A completed snapshot is verified in place against every pin and reused without copying or re-downloading; staging is renamed, never copied.
protocol.hash_verification: Exact SHA256 over the full file bytes for all weight shards, indexes, tokenizer assets, configuration and remote-code sources.
protocol.header_vs_weights: The manifest records which bytes are actual weight payload and keeps preparation-phase safetensors header evidence in a separate header block.
protocol.failed_run_evidence: A failed acquisition leaves enclosing evidence and staging bytes in place, writes a timestamped failure receipt beside the target (never overwriting prior receipts), and never deletes user or previous evidence.
protocol.offline_validation: scripts/acquire_spark_weights.py --offline re-verifies completed snapshots with zero network requests.
protocol.network_requests: Only pinned huggingface.co resolve URLs at the exact official revisions; redirects are followed by urllib and the pinned total size must match.
protocol.model_execution: Never imports torch, transformers, safetensors or remote Python; acquisition is a byte-level operation only.
protocol.fresh_outputs: A --receipt path must not already exist. Failure receipts are timestamped, never overwritten, and staging plus partial bytes are retained for inspection or verified resume.
protocol.budget: A single 40 GiB budget covers both weight payloads, same-filesystem staging, the isolated Spark environment and all evidence; the manifest and receipt report free bytes before/after, staged bytes, final bytes and the high-water estimate.

environment.isolation: dedicated .venv-spark environment; the locked MiniCPM5 environment is not modified
environment.mps_fp8_claim: none; acquisition does not qualify any backend

data_access.note: Acquisition touches only the two official model repositories. No train/dev/heldout split is read or materialised, and no heldout split may be opened after any failure.

non_claims: Acquisition is not a successful model load.
The FP8 snapshot is not proven executable on MPS or CPU.
The BF16 control is not a dequantized substitute for the FP8 source.
Header evidence from the preparation phase is not weight-payload evidence.
No training data, train/dev/heldout split or model quality claim is implied.
